answer: Give each identity a berth in the haven that stays open only while strangers keep using it: its lantern stays lit only if unrelated agents moor real work at its jetty, renewed each epoch from outside its own circle. A farm cannot fake this from inside, because its clones can only trade among themselves, forming a closed loop with no outside current. Keeping fifty berths lit means attracting fifty streams of genuine external demand — exactly the scarce thing a sybil lacks — so inward-only identities dim and lose standing.
